newsitem.title: USA: LaTex attributes year loss to merger costs.
newsitem.headline: LaTex attributes year loss to merger costs.

text.p: LaTex Resources Inc on Tuesday blamed writeoffs associated with its pending merger with Alliance Resources Plc as the primary reason for a fiscal year loss that widened despite rising revenues.
The company reported a net loss of $10.8 million, or $0.60 per share, on revenues of $13.5 million for the fiscal year ending July 31, 1996.
In fiscal 1995 the company reported a net loss of $2.6 million, or $0.15 per share, on revenues of $10.4 million.
Under the merger terms, LaTex is disposing of its interests in Wexford Technology Inc, Imperial Petroleum Inc, LaTex Resources International Inc and Phoenix Metals Inc.

The company said the writeoffs included a $3.6 million writeoff of Latex Resources International, $4.2 million in equity losses and asset writedowns, hedging losses of $1.4 million and $1.8 million for disposing a subsidiary as required under the merger.
LaTex said it also recognized a $2.4 million gain for selling nonstrategic assets in fiscal 1996.
